$comment: The hosted MCP gateway's error codes (blowhorn-ai/blowhorn internal/design/structured-error-codes.md), in the shape of blowhorn-ai/blowhorn's engine registry. Literal text only; nothing is built at run time. Every definition validates against the vendored ErrorDefinition construct (hosted/schemas/vendor/blowhorn/schemas/dist/ErrorDefinition.schema.json), checked by make hosted-check. The numbers are provisional until the registry (blowhorn-ai/blowhorn#1662) allocates them. No remediation carries an action: only a person or their client can do any of them. src/errors.js maps each outcome the gateway reports to its code in CODES, and lists the retired codes (1000-1009, from the 0.1.x gateway that ran tools itself) in RETIRED: tombstones whose definitions stay here so a number is never reused. A 429's error.data is the blowhorn-mcp-1010 definition with only the refusing limit's cause. nextErrorCode is one past the highest, checked by make hosted-check.

definitions.shortDescription: The tool is not one this gateway offers.
definitions.longDescription: Retired: the gateway 0.2.0 no longer runs tools, so nothing reports this code; Blowhorn Cloud does. The number is kept so it is never reused. A tools/call named a tool that is not in the gateway's catalog. The catalog is generated from the vendored meshery/schemas operations and holds only reads, so nothing was sent to Blowhorn Cloud.

probableCauses.description: The client asked for a tool this gateway does not offer, or mistyped its name.

remediations.description: Ask for the tool list again and use one of the names it returns.

definitions.shortDescription: The arguments did not match the tool's input schema.
definitions.longDescription: Retired: the gateway 0.2.0 no longer runs tools, so nothing reports this code; Blowhorn Cloud does. The number is kept so it is never reused. The gateway checks every call's arguments against the tool's input schema before it sends anything. These did not pass, so nothing was sent to Blowhorn Cloud. The answer names the failing locations, never the values.

probableCauses.description: An argument is missing, unknown, or of the wrong type or size.

remediations.description: Check the argument names and limits in the tool list, then send the call again.

definitions.shortDescription: The gateway refused to send the request.
definitions.longDescription: Retired: the gateway 0.2.0 no longer runs tools, so nothing reports this code; Blowhorn Cloud does. The number is kept so it is never reused. The arguments passed the tool's schema, but the request they make is one the gateway never sends, such as a path value that is not one segment or a URL over 8 KB. Nothing was sent to Blowhorn Cloud.

probableCauses.description: A path value is not a single valid segment.

remediations.description: Send a value that names one resource.

probableCauses.description: The request URL would be over 8 KB.

remediations.description: Send shorter arguments.

definitions.shortDescription: Blowhorn Cloud answered with a client error.
definitions.longDescription: Retired: the gateway 0.2.0 no longer runs tools, so nothing reports this code; Blowhorn Cloud does. The number is kept so it is never reused. The gateway sent the call to Blowhorn Cloud with the caller's own token, and Cloud answered with a 4xx status. The tool result carries Cloud's message.

remediations.description: Check the identifiers in the call.

probableCauses.description: Your account cannot read it in the organization given.

remediations.description: Check organizationId, and that your account can access the resource there.

definitions.shortDescription: Blowhorn Cloud answered with a server error.
definitions.longDescription: Retired: the gateway 0.2.0 no longer runs tools, so nothing reports this code; Blowhorn Cloud does. The number is kept so it is never reused. The gateway sent the call to Blowhorn Cloud, and Cloud answered with a 5xx status. The call is a read, so trying it again is safe.

probableCauses.description: Blowhorn Cloud had a problem handling the request.

remediations.description: Try again in a few minutes.
If it keeps failing, contact Blowhorn support.

definitions.shortDescription: Blowhorn Cloud did not answer in time.
definitions.longDescription: Retired: the gateway 0.2.0 no longer runs tools, so nothing reports this code; Blowhorn Cloud does. The number is kept so it is never reused. The gateway gives each call to Blowhorn Cloud 20 seconds, for the status and the whole body. Cloud's answer did not arrive in that time, so the gateway stopped waiting.

probableCauses.description: Blowhorn Cloud was slow to answer.

remediations.description: Try again in a few minutes.

probableCauses.description: The call asked for too much at once.

remediations.description: Ask for a smaller page of results.

definitions.shortDescription: The gateway could not reach Blowhorn Cloud.
definitions.longDescription: Retired: the gateway 0.2.0 no longer runs tools, so nothing reports this code; Blowhorn Cloud does. The number is kept so it is never reused. The gateway could not open a connection to Blowhorn Cloud, or the connection failed before an answer came back. The call is a read, so trying it again is safe.

probableCauses.description: Blowhorn Cloud or the network between it and the gateway was unavailable.

remediations.description: Try again in a few minutes.

definitions.shortDescription: Blowhorn Cloud answered with a redirect, which the gateway does not follow.
definitions.longDescription: Retired: the gateway 0.2.0 no longer runs tools, so nothing reports this code; Blowhorn Cloud does. The number is kept so it is never reused. The gateway never follows a redirect, so the caller's token can never be sent anywhere but Blowhorn Cloud's API. Cloud, or something in front of it, answered with one.

probableCauses.description: Blowhorn Cloud moved the endpoint, or a proxy in front of it redirected the call.

remediations.description: Try again in a few minutes.
If it keeps failing, contact Blowhorn support.

definitions.shortDescription: Blowhorn Cloud's answer was too large to return.
definitions.longDescription: Retired: the gateway 0.2.0 no longer runs tools, so nothing reports this code; Blowhorn Cloud does. The number is kept so it is never reused. The gateway returns at most 2 MB of Blowhorn Cloud's answer to one call. This answer was larger, so the gateway stopped reading it and returned nothing from it.

probableCauses.description: The call matched more data than the gateway returns in one answer.

remediations.description: Ask for a smaller page of results, or add filters to narrow the call.

definitions.shortDescription: Blowhorn Cloud's answer was not JSON.
definitions.longDescription: Retired: the gateway 0.2.0 no longer runs tools, so nothing reports this code; Blowhorn Cloud does. The number is kept so it is never reused. Every Blowhorn Cloud API the gateway calls answers with JSON. This answer did not parse as JSON, so the gateway returned none of it.

probableCauses.description: Blowhorn Cloud answered with an unexpected body, or a proxy answered in its place.

remediations.description: Try again in a few minutes.
If it keeps failing, contact Blowhorn support.

definitions.shortDescription: Too many requests: the gateway's rate limit refused this one.
definitions.longDescription: The gateway limits how many tool calls one token can make, and how many requests one network address can send, in a minute, so a runaway client cannot flood Blowhorn Cloud or the activity feed. This request was over a limit, so nothing was sent to Cloud and nothing was recorded in your activity. The Retry-After header says how many seconds to wait.

probableCauses.description: This token made more tool calls than the per-minute limit allows, often an agent calling a tool in a loop.

remediations.description: Wait the number of seconds in the Retry-After header, then send the call again.
Send fewer, larger calls: for example, ask for bigger pages instead of many small ones.

probableCauses.description: Requests from every client on this network address count together, and together they passed the per-address limit.

remediations.description: Wait the number of seconds in the Retry-After header, then send the call again.
Send fewer requests from this address, for example by reusing one session instead of initializing before every call.

definitions.shortDescription: The gateway could not reach Blowhorn Cloud.
definitions.longDescription: The gateway carries every MCP request to Blowhorn Cloud's /mcp endpoint unchanged. It could not open a connection to Cloud, or the connection failed before an answer came back, so nothing was returned from Cloud. The request is answered 502.

probableCauses.description: Blowhorn Cloud or the network between it and the gateway was unavailable.

remediations.description: Try again in a few minutes.
If it keeps failing, contact Blowhorn support.

definitions.shortDescription: Blowhorn Cloud did not start answering in time.
definitions.longDescription: The gateway gives Blowhorn Cloud 20 seconds to start its answer (the status and headers). Cloud did not, so the gateway stopped waiting and answered 504. A streamed body, once it has started, is not timed out.

probableCauses.description: Blowhorn Cloud was slow to answer.

remediations.description: Try again in a few minutes.

definitions.shortDescription: Blowhorn Cloud answered with a redirect, which the gateway does not follow.
definitions.longDescription: The gateway never follows a redirect, so a caller's credentials can never be sent anywhere but Blowhorn Cloud's /mcp endpoint, and it never hands a Cloud redirect to the client. Cloud, or something in front of it, answered with one; the gateway answered 502.

probableCauses.description: Blowhorn Cloud moved the endpoint, or a proxy in front of it redirected the request.

remediations.description: Try again in a few minutes.
If it keeps failing, contact Blowhorn support.
